assertion: overflow-wrap:anywhere breaks an otherwise unbreakable word into two four-glyph lines inside a 100px content width.

browser.reason: Reviewed the two four-glyph lines in all three browsers. Chrome and Firefox agree exactly with independent line positions; WebKit has a 0.281px baseline offset. Differences against Chrome are glyph rasterization: 1244 contour pixels and two pixels inside M diagonals differing by 5/255. Only those two low-delta pixels are allowed outside the contour.
